trace.query: Where is the Guidance Office located?

SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_717
SECTION: LSPU-LB CAMPUS MAP: LOCATIONS AND WALKING DIRECTIONS FROM THE MAIN GATE
Student ID processing is handled by this office.
Located in the LSPU-LB campus, Malinta, Los Baños, Laguna.
Also known as: BAO, Business Affairs, where to process student ID.
Source: Map of LSPU-LB (campus map, walking directions from the main gate).

LOCATION: Scholarship and Financial Assistance (SFA) Office
Directions from the main gate: From the main gate, walk straight in. The Scholarship and Financial Assistance office is inside the BAO, in the same building as the Clinic and Cafeteria, on the left side.
Located in the LSPU-LB campus, Malinta, Los Baños, Laguna.
Also known as: SFA, scholarship office, financial assistance office.
Source: Map of LSPU-LB (campus map, walking directions from the main gate).

LOCATION: Office of the Registrar
Directions from the main gate: From the main gate, turn left and follow the road-side path to the Administration Building. Go up to the second floor. The Registrar's Office is on that floor.
Located in the LSPU-LB campus, Malinta, Los Baños, Laguna.
Also known as: Registrar, registrar's office, where to get COR TOR.
Source: Map of LSPU-LB (campus map, walking directions from the main gate).

LOCATION: Campus Library

EMERGENCY CONTACT: GUIDANCE OFFICE (EMOTIONAL OR MENTAL HEALTH CRISIS)
Source: Student Handbook Chapter 5, Article 1, Sec. 2 and the Mental Health Services articles; the 911 advice and the office location are from the maintainer and general safety information.
The Guidance Office (inside the OSAS building) offers counseling and mental health support to enrolled students. Go there for emotional distress, mental health concerns, and support after a bullying or harassment incident.
If you or someone else is in immediate danger, call 911 first.
No direct Guidance Office phone number has been supplied. The campus main line is (049) 308-4530 (Mon-Fri, 8:00 AM-5:00 PM).

are at the gym end. The CCS Faculty Room, ITSO, TSL Room and the Psychology Lab/Logistics Office are at the gate end.

Source: Map of LSPU-LB (campus map, walking directions from the main gate).

LOCATION: CAS Building (College of Arts and Sciences)
Directions from the main gate: From the main gate, turn right and walk past CBAA. CAS is the long purple building parallel to CCS, set back from the road. The CAS Dean's Office, the Faculty Room and the classrooms are inside.
Located in the LSPU-LB campus, Malinta, Los Baños, Laguna.
Also known as: CAS, College of Arts and Sciences building.
Source: Map of LSPU-LB (campus map, walking directions from the main gate).

LOCATION: CTE Building (College of Teacher Education)
Directions from the main gate: From the main gate, turn right and walk past Lacson Gym and CCS to the far end of the campus. CTE is the dark blue building group. The CTE Dean's Office, Faculty Room, GSAE Office and classrooms are inside.
Located in the LSPU-LB campus, Malinta, Los Baños, Laguna.
